notes.text: LSU looked genuinely tough in a 51-10 dismantling of Clemson — biggest statement win of the week. Model AND market both badly underrated them (missed by 33 and 31).
Michigan eked out 13-12 at home vs Western Michigan — pathetic for that program while other top teams won by 40+. W2 line (Mich -18.2) was 9 pts closer to reality than the market (-27.5).

Oregon only beat Boise State 34-27, but Boise is a quality Week 1 opponent vs the cupcakes everyone else played — read that as galvanizing, not alarming. SRS agrees: that win credits more than Georgia's 60-pt win over an FCS team.

METHOD: two bugs found and fixed this week — (1) in-season weight was computed from games-played/total, over-crediting wk1 at 29.5%; now avg games per team = 21.4%. (2) SRS iteration oscillated on the sparse wk1 graph, collapsing LSU/Clemson/Michigan/Oregon to one identical value; added 0.5 damping (dense 2025 season unchanged).
